en.headline: Digital Policy Office reviews overnight staffing after unanswered 1823 call about…
en.dek: The office said a call at about 1:56am on Monday reporting a dying monkey in Sham Shui Po was logged and referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, while earlier calls went to voicemail.
body: The Digital Policy Office said on Monday it had noted media reports that a member of the public tried to report a dying monkey on Tai Po Road in Sham Shui Po to the 1823 hotline but did not get through to staff.

According to the office’s system records, a caller at about 1:56am reported a dying monkey on a slope opposite the China Petroleum station at 338 Tai Po Road. The customer service officer logged the case and immediately referred it to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, also telephoning the department’s duty officer because it was treated as urgent.

The office said it was also aware of another call around 1am the same morning that went to voicemail because all on-duty staff were handling other calls, and the caller left no message. It described the episode as showing room for improvement in the 1823 service and said it would review the situation and study adding more overnight staffing to enhance the hotline.

zh.headline: 數字辦檢討1823深宵人手 回應未接聽罵死猴子報案
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室表示，周一凌晨約時56分有市民致電1823報告深水埗大埔道有罵死猴子，職員已記錄並即時轉介漁農自然護理署，另有較早來電因當值人員忙碌而轉往留言信箱。
body: 數字政策辦公室周一表示，留意到傳媒報道指有市民欲向1823報告深水埗大埔道有罵死猴子，但未獲職員接聽。
根據1823系統紀錄，有市民於凌晨約時56分致電，報告大埔道338號中國石油站對面山坡有罵死猴子，要求處理。客戶服務主任記錄個案，並即時轉介漁農自然護理署跟進；由於屬緊急個案，職員亦即時致電通知該署當值人員處理。
數字辦同時留意到同日凌晨約時許另有來電，因當時所有當值職員均在處理其他來電，來電被轉駁至留言信箱，惟來電人未有留言，故未能跟進。數字辦認為事件顯示1823服務有改善空間，會檢視情況並研究增加深宵時段人手，以改進服務。
